|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Come Here You Big Coward (Reflections III) (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Come Here You Big Coward (Reflections III) (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 9 April 2025<ref name="ht-e6f69d5">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual25-Dark/large/comehereyoubigcoward.gif</code> as published 9 April 2025: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/e6f69d52659159101b647b96a00a4cd5939e189e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/comehereyoubigcoward.gif holotable commit e6f69d5] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Plays on table. Sectors are not battlegrounds. While you occupy a battleground and opponent occupies less than two battlegrounds, cancels: Asteroid Sanctuary, opponent's Force drains at non-battleground locations, and opponent's Force retrieval.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Come Here You Big Coward (Reflections III) (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 10 August 2025: “Plays on table. Sectors are not battlegrounds. While you occupy a battleground and opponent occupies less than two battlegrounds, cancels: Asteroid Sanctuary, opponent's Force drains at non-battleground locations, and opponent's Force retrieval.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Come Here You Big Coward (Reflections III) (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Come Here You Big Coward (Reflections III)”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Come Here You Big Coward (Reflections III) (V)]] (published 9 April 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Come Here You Big Coward (Defensive Shield)]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
